correctness.rationale: For each surviving set T, GRS equivalence is reduced to existence of a nondegenerate conic through the projective columns. Exact modular row reduction of the quadratic-evaluation matrix over all subsets of sizes 5 through 9 gives ranks 6 for all 9-, 8-, and 7-sets; ranks 5 for exactly six of 84 six-sets; and rank 5 for all 126 five-sets. All 84 triples of source columns have rank 3, so the relevant punctures remain dimension-three MDS codes. Degenerate conics cannot contain five points of an arc.
